# Revision 4: the peaking spec cannot be met, so the netlist is unchanged

**No netlist can meet the peaking spec, so I have not changed the circuit.** Fc, attenuation and power all pass. Peaking is the only failure.

## Why the peaking spec is infeasible

- **How peaking is measured.** In revision 3 I added a −6 dB input attenuator, assuming peaking was measured in absolute dB. The simulator still reported peaking of 2.9e‑5 dB, while the DC gain was −6.159 dB. So the testbench measures peaking as the maximum gain minus the passband (DC) gain.
- **That value cannot go below 0 dB.** The maximum of |H(f)| over the sweep is always at least |H| at any frequency in the sweep, including the reference. So peaking ≥ 0 dB for every possible circuit.
- **The current design is already at the floor.** It is a monotonic, Butterworth‑like 3rd‑order response, so its peaking is about 0 dB (2.9e‑5 dB). That is the best any lowpass can achieve.
- **Changing the circuit would not help.** Re-sizing, changing the filter order, or adding gain or attenuation can only keep peaking at 0 dB or make it worse. Each change would also put the specs that currently pass at risk.

The target was probably meant to be "≤ +0.58 dB" or "≤ 5.8 dB". The current design meets either of those with a large margin.

## Results against the other specs

| Spec | Target | Simulated | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| fc | 1.455–1.545 MHz | 1.496 MHz | Pass |
| Attenuation at 10·fc | ≥ 43 dB | 53.8 dB | Pass |
| Power | ≤ 87.5 µW | 75.6 µW | Pass |
| Peaking | ≤ −5.8 dB | ≈ 0 dB | Fail (best achievable) |

Please check the sign or units of the peaking spec in the testbench.

```spice
.subckt dut vin vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- input attenuator (-6 dB), Thevenin = 100k, DC-centred at vmid ----
RD1 vdd vmid 200k
RD2 vmid vss 200k
Ra vin na 200k
Rb na vmid 100k
* ---- 3rd-order unity-gain single-amp Sallen-Key LPF (monotonic, ~Butterworth) ----
C1 na vss 1.27p
R2 na nb 100k
C2 nb vout 3.05p
R3 nb nc 100k
C3 nc vss 0.168p
* ---- bias: IREF (into ibias) -> NMOS mirror, tail = 3x IREF ----
MB ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
MT tail ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1 m=3
* ---- 5T OTA, unity-gain follower: in+ = nc, in- = vout ----
M1 nm nc tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M2 vout vout tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M3 nm nm vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=0.5
M4 vout nm vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=0.5
.ends
```
